gaps.explanation: Two printed differences, both kept as printed. (1) American Rescue Plan Act fund: its budget schedule (p9) prints Total Receipts 2,015,782 (Intergovernmental 2,013,183 + Interest 2,599), but the fund is not a column of the governmental funds statement (p4; columns General, Road, Public Safety Communication, Inheritance, Road/Bridge Improvement District, Jail Bond, Jail Capital Project, Other Governmental Funds, Total) - the schedule covers a fund outside the statement's scope (FY2023 adds it as a prior period adjustment), so detail is +2,015,782 above the statement. (2) Hard Surfacing Fund: its budget schedule (p13) prints the 263,920 as 'Transfers in (out)' (other financing), while the statement prints it as Miscellaneous receipts in Other Governmental Funds 263,920 (p4), so detail revenue is 263,920 below the statement here. Arithmetic: schedule 24,885,536 - 2,015,782 + 263,920 = 23,133,674 = printed Total Receipts (p4); gap -1,751,862 = -2,015,782 + 263,920. No fix (both schedules print these amounts).

American Rescue Plan Act fund budget schedule (p9) prints Disbursements 'Other' 103,028 (Total Disbursements 103,028); the fund is not in the governmental funds statement (p4, Total Disbursements 24,776,979). Schedule 24,880,007 - 103,028 = 24,776,979. Fund outside the statement's scope; no fix.

Hard Surfacing Fund budget schedule (p13) prints 'Transfers in (out)' actual 263,920; the governmental funds statement prints that amount as Miscellaneous receipts (Other Governmental Funds 263,920, p4) and its Transfers in are Road 4,400,000 + Road/Bridge Improvement District 415,000 + Other Governmental Funds 403,478 = 5,218,478 (p4). No fund prints a matching transfer out. Schedule 5,482,398 - 263,920 = 5,218,478; the schedule classifies the 263,920 differently. No fix.
